verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a dedicated self-hosting section offering multiple deployment methods to run your own instance, including Docker Compose for quick or small-scale setups. It also describes itself as open source, with the GitHub repo and an "OSS" llms.txt corroborating this. The Commons Clause licensing note concerns license terminology, not whether self-hosting works, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: details of the other deployment methods (e.g., production-scale options), any statement of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud, and independent or hands-on reports of successful self-hosting.
